steps.finding: The request asks for business performance metrics including Net Sales, Net Sales Growth, Forecast Variance, and On-Time In-Full for Nubeqa and Eylea in Latin America.
AST-0335-v2 ('All Pharma Growth Legacy') ranks top by covering 57% of the request requirements with a trust score of 0.60.
AST-0335-v2 has a healthy refresh model (SM-069) with promoted endorsement, but lacks net_sales_growth, forecast_variance, and on_time_in_full.
Governance findings show owner OWN-043 is inactive, trigger a retirement warning due to 0 average monthly users, and flag RULE-003 for reassignment.
Secondary assets like AST-0015 also cover 57% of the request, but AST-0335-v2 remains the leading Power BI baseline to enhance.

why: Extending AST-0335-v2 allows us to leverage an existing Power BI dashboard with a healthy data model while adding the missing KPIs and reassigning ownership. This avoids building from scratch while addressing the governance flags.
risks: The assigned owner OWN-043 is inactive and requires immediate reassignment.
AST-0335-v2 has low usage (0 avg monthly users) and is flagged as a retirement candidate.
Three required metrics (net_sales_growth, forecast_variance, on_time_in_full) are currently missing.
